scientific_scope: A public-input, macrocycle-site pose-stability pilot for PaG versus glucose. This would not be an exact rerun of the 2026 MD, a binding-affinity calculation, a receptor assay, or a clinical prediction.

published_method.starting_coordinates: In-house crystal structure of a related glucose-bound macrocycle; not supplied in the reviewed public Supporting Information.

proxy_input.structure_source: 2024 Springer Nature Figshare author-supplied NNC2215 open/closed model PDBs
proxy_input.model_status: Publisher-supplied model-built coordinates; not experimentally resolved NNC2215 coordinates.
proxy_input.system_boundary: NNC2215 and its macrocycle site only; no insulin receptor. Public model geometry differs from the 2026 macrocycle-analogue crystal input, so results would be a proxy study.
proxy_input.coordinate_search: The 2026 article/SI and associated public model materials were reviewed; no original seed coordinate file was found. Study authors have not yet been contacted.
before_run_blockers: Resolve duplicate atom names in PHX, LYX, and MC residues against authoritative chemical graphs.
Reconcile open-state MC C31–LYX CD6 versus closed-state MC C31–LYX C LINK records.
Validate complete conjugate bond orders, stereochemistry, protonation, partial charges, and force-field compatibility.
Document a reproducible PaG pose-generation procedure; do not use docking scores as affinity estimates.
Select one consistent force-field strategy and validate all nonstandard components before system preparation.

design.base_state: Public open-state NNC2215 model, with any removal or replacement of the modelled free glucose documented as an explicit model edit.

conditions.composition: NNC2215 macrocycle-site model without free glucose or PaG
Same model with the source-model glucose pose retained or rebuilt and documented
Same model with PaG placed using the documented pose-generation protocol

design.pH_assumption: Physiological target pH 7.4 represented by explicit protonation assignments; a pH label alone does not change a conventional fixed-protonation MD system.
design.pag_protonation: Glucuronate carboxylate deprotonated, net ligand charge -1, subject to full conjugate/solvent charge validation.
design.water_and_salt: Use the documented 2026 SPC water and 0.15 M NaCl only if supported and validated in the selected engine/force-field combination.
design.concentration_interpretation: One seeded ligand in a periodic box is a pose-stability condition, not a 70 μM bulk-concentration reproduction. Box composition, finite-size effects, and initial occupancy must be reported.

observables: Macrocycle heavy-atom RMSD after alignment to the initial model
Ligand heavy-atom RMSD and retention in the starting pocket
Ligand–macrocycle contact occupancy and hydrogen-bond geometry
Water-mediated contacts and key pocket distances
Temperature, pressure, volume, total/potential energy, and structural integrity
Between-replicate variability and sensitivity to documented pose/preparation choices
success_criteria: All structure and parameterization blockers above pass with versioned evidence before production starts.
All replicas complete without crashes, non-finite energies, severe geometry failures, or sustained ensemble drift.
Qualitative ligand-pose stability results are reported across independent seeds with uncertainty; loss of pose is reported as inconclusive rather than proof of non-binding.
No affinity, free energy, or receptor-activity claim is made from contact counts or short pose-stability runs.
stop_criteria: Any unresolved atom mapping, bond order, stereochemistry, charge, protonation, or force-field incompatibility.
No reproducible PaG pose protocol or no independent replicate agreement in a qualitative observable.

compute_plan.benchmark: Measure the prepared target system on the allocated GPU before estimating hours or cost; local 1UBQ Apple M4 results are not transferable.
compute_plan.gpu_hours_formula: 450 ns / measured target-system ns-per-day * 24, plus separately measured setup and analysis overhead.
compute_plan.scale_up_rule: Consider the paper's 500 ns production scale only after the 50 ns pilot passes diagnostics and the measured budget is approved.
